items.summary: A police officer who shot a Black man in the head during an attempted arrest in Mississauga, Ont., nearly seven years ago told a coroner’s inquest Tuesday that he did not make a conscious decision to open fire but instead acted out of a ‘fight-or-flight’ instinct.

items.title: Thomas Markle indicted in U.S. on two counts of possessing child sexual abuse material
items.summary: Thomas Markle, the estranged father of Britain’s Duchess of Sussex, Meghan Markle, and father-in-law of Britain’s Prince Harry, was indicted on Tuesday in U.S. federal court in Los Angeles on two counts of possessing child sexual abuse material.
